name: Amazon Listing Verification
description: Check one selected Amazon listing by ASIN or Amazon product URL. Fetch its current product page details and create a dated Canvas evidence brief. Does not search other products, purchase, or infer missing delivery or total cost.

steps.abort_speech: Provide one Amazon ASIN or product URL after /verify_amazon.
steps.description: Fetch one exact Amazon product page without a search fan-out
Save a source-linked check for this exact listing

success_speech: Checked the Amazon listing and saved the dated verification brief to Canvas: ${canvas_url}.
abort_speech: I could not verify that Amazon listing. Provide a valid ASIN or product URL and try again.
